## FindingCode type

Enumerated finding codes. Additive — new codes arrive in toolkit MINOR releases; removing or renaming a code is MAJOR. Consumers SHOULD handle unknown codes gracefully.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type FindingCode = 'envelope-invalid' | 'repo-config-invalid' | 'envelope-adherence' | 'schema-invalid' | 'name-consistency' | 'mcp-key-sync' | 'marketplace-registration' | 'freshness';
```
